ZIG SIM PRO is an app for "the physical prototyping".
In ZIG SIM PRO, it is possible to send not only the sensor information obtained with the existing free application ZIG SIM but also the feature point information obtained with ARKit to the specified device.

You can monitor such as the feature point data obtained with ARKit as well as data obtained with the existing free ZIGSIM, and send it to a destination device by TCP or UDP.

For that reason, even without electronic kits, you can also experiment IoT related the video system.

Some functions may not be available depending on the model.
- Features other than NFC Reader are available on iOS 12.3.1 iPad Pro.
- Features other than Apple Pencil are available on iOS 12.3.1 iPhone X&11.
- NDI function Depth cannot be used on models that do not have a Dual camera.
- NDI function HUMAN cannot be used on models that do not equip with A12 chip and higher.
- ARKit function FaceTracking cannot be used on models that do not have a TrueDepth camera.
- ARKit function BodyTracking cannot be used on models that do not equip with A12 chip and higher.
- NFC Reader function cannot be used on models that do not have a NFC Chip.

•gravity from accel

•compass
